records.title: PTM4Tag
records.rationale: Pre-trained-model tag recommendation for Stack Overflow posts; no LLM agents, no orchestration, and no single-agent versus multi-agent comparison.

records.title: Proceedings of the 2026 34th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Program Comprehension
records.rationale: Conference proceedings front matter for ICPC rather than a primary study; contains no findings, architecture, or failure-mode analysis to screen.

records.title: Blockchain challenges and opportunities: a survey
records.rationale: 2018 blockchain technology survey covering consensus algorithms and distributed ledger applications; predates the window and involves no LLM agents.

records.title: Proceedings of the 18th International Conference on Evaluation and Assessment in Software Engineering
records.rationale: EASE 2014 proceedings preface describing the program and acceptance rates; not a study and far predates LLM-based agent research.

records.title: Metrics and Models in Software Quality Engineering
records.rationale: 1996 classical software quality metrics text pulled in by backward citation; no LLM component and no agent architecture.
Russian-language narrative synthesis of cognitive biases in the innovation economy; non-English and unrelated to software engineering or LLM agents.

records.title: Towards improving decision making and estimating the value of decisions in value-based software engineering: the VALUE framework
records.rationale: Value-based software engineering decision framework using Bayesian networks and stakeholder elicitation; human decision support with no LLM agents involved.

records.title: Managing software requirements: a unified approach
records.rationale: 1999 practitioner book on use-case-driven requirements management; classical requirements engineering with no automated or LLM-based agents.

records.title: Proactive Risk Management
records.rationale: Project risk management book on risk drivers and quantification for product development; no software agent system or LLM evaluation.

records.title: Agile and Iterative Development: A Manager's Guide
records.rationale: 2003 management guide comparing Scrum, XP, RUP, and Evo for human development teams; no LLM-based agents or automated orchestration.

records.title: Requirements engineering in the year 00
records.rationale: Roadmap paper on goal-oriented requirements engineering processes; its "agents" are humans, devices, and software components, not LLM-based agents.

records.title: Proceedings of the 16th ACM SIGSOFT International Symposium on Foundations of software engineering
records.rationale: FSE-16 proceedings welcome message summarizing the 2008 program; no research content relevant to any research question.

records.title: Attribute-Based Access Control
records.rationale: Overview of ABAC policy models for distributed systems; a security primitive with no LLM agents or software engineering agent evaluation.

records.title: Concepts and paradigms of object-oriented programming
records.rationale: 1990 OOPSLA keynote paper on object-oriented language design and concurrency models; foundational programming-languages material, not agentic LLM work.

records.title: What makes a good bug report?
records.rationale: Developer survey on bug report quality in Apache, Eclipse, and Mozilla; human-authored reports with no LLM agent or multi-agent configuration.

records.title: Code Generation in Action
records.rationale: 2003 book on template- and model-driven code generators for application tiers; deterministic tooling rather than LLM-based agents.

records.title: Big Data and Due Process: Toward a Framework to Redress Predictive Privacy Harms
records.rationale: Legal scholarship proposing procedural data due process for private big-data profiling; a privacy law argument outside software engineering agent research.

records.title: Privacy Amplification by Public Discussion
records.rationale: 1988 cryptography result on distilling secret keys over authenticated public channels; "discussion" here is a protocol primitive, not agent dialogue.

records.title: Issues in Requirements Elicitation
records.rationale: 1992 technical report proposing a human-centered requirements elicitation methodology; no LLM agents and predates the eligibility window.

records.title: A Unified Model of Requirements Elicitation
records.rationale: Process model of analyst-driven requirements elicitation emphasizing situational knowledge; entirely human process with no LLM agent involvement.

records.title: Automatic code generation from design patterns
records.rationale: 1996 tool that emits design-pattern boilerplate from user-supplied parameters; rule-based generation with no language model or agent orchestration.

records.title: Autonomous Agents
records.rationale: Philosophy monograph on self-control, free will, and personal autonomy in humans; a pure title collision on the word "agents".

records.title: Distributed Agile Development: Using Scrum in a Large Project
records.rationale: Case study of Scrum coordination across a 40-person human team in Norway and Malaysia; human distributed collaboration, not LLM agent orchestration.

records.title: Modeling Adaptive Autonomous Agents
records.rationale: Artificial Life review of ethology-inspired adaptive autonomous agents; explicitly non-LLM classical agent research excluded by the protocol.

records.title: COMPETENCY MAPPING: A GAP ANALYSIS
records.rationale: Human-resources study measuring managerial skill gaps via questionnaires; unrelated to software engineering agents despite the specialization framing.

records.title: Autonomous Agents: From Self-Control to Autonomy
records.rationale: Philosophical Review book review of Mele's monograph on autonomy and determinism; another keyword collision with no computational content.

records.title: Proceedings of the twenty-second ACM SIGMOD-SIGACT-SIGART symposium on Principles of database systems
records.rationale: PODS 2003 proceedings preface listing accepted papers and awards; database theory venue material with no relevance to LLM agent research.
